heading: **7 February 2026**
body:
*HTFS ligation purification*

Pool the 2 reactions of each type \- 147 & N40

Add 0.2 uL 10% SDS & 0.4 uL Proteinase K. Incubate at RT for 20-30 mins.

Use Ampure XP beads to purify the ligation products. Measure concentration of products using Qubit.

*pHRS library in vitro CRISPR*

1. Gcla dam-/dcm-  
2. Gcla dam-/dcm- gHRS  
3. Gcla dam-/dcm- gCON  
4. ELF2lig1  
5. ELF2lig1 (EcoRV)

HAP1 media (500 mL)

| IMDM | Make up to 500 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
